exchange-rate.description: A simple MCP server for currency exchange data. It provides tools to fetch live rates, convert amounts, and retrieve all rates for a base currency in a clean, structured format.
exchange-rate.author: agenticmarket

hackernews.description: A simple MCP server that brings Hacker News into your AI workflows. It exposes a set of tools to fetch top stories, individual posts with comments, and the latest Ask HN / Show HN discussions — all in a clean, structured format that’s easy for agents
hackernews.author: agenticmarket
